name: Suggested_Actions
label: Suggested Actions
_about: The lookup the sorting engine uses for the suggested_action text (spec 05 / 01 section 3; 01 Database suggested_actions). Admin-editable. A row here replaces the built-in default for the same Module + Condition code (Category blank = any category). Fulfillment condition codes: above_line, below_line, blocked_payment, blocked_items, blocked_exception, blocked_address, blocked_contact.

fields.name: Module
fields.label: Module
fields.helpText: Fulfillment (the Delivery and Procurement rows belong to their own engines).

fields.name: Category
fields.label: Category
fields.helpText: broken, late, at_risk, on_time or blocked; leave blank for any.
